name: The Ember
subtitle: Confidence Bracelet · Carnelian
promise: Carnelian alone. A small fire on the wrist.
body: Eight-millimetre carnelian in glossy burnt orange with soft natural banding, strung without any metal. Traditionally worn for courage, drive and creative energy. Real stock from the studio, and once these are gone we will not restring them.
seoDescription: Carnelian bracelet, traditionally worn for confidence, drive and creativity. Last pieces, hand-strung in Dubai, next-day delivery across the UAE.
